modules.module_title: Prepare for installation of protected cultivation structure/s

pcs.pc_description: select a site suitable for protected cultivation
gather details of the crops to be grown such as growing period, growing media and growing system, environmental conditions required, etc.
identify the type/s of protected cultivation structure/s to be installed based on the information gathered about site, soil and climatic conditions
check the structure's material, orientation, dimensions, length-width proportions, roofing, sloping, insulation, ventilation, provision for sunlight, etc.
check for electricity and water supply, storage, filtration and distribution provisions
select the environmental control solutions for cooling, heating, humidification, fertigation, lighting, enriching gaseous composition, irrigation, fogging, pesticide spraying, etc.
select the vendor and place order for appropriate protected cultivation structure, accessories and environment control technologies
organize the implements, equipment and materials required for installation of the protected cultivation structure
prepare the site for installation of protected cultivation structure

modules.module_title: Supervise installation of protected cultivation structure/s

pcs.pc_description: ensure the basic framework for the protected cultivation structure/s is installed as per the desired stability and specifications

supervise the installation process of auxiliary facilities such as electric points and wiring, water supply and storage, maintenance workshop, communication systems, physical barriers for pests, wind, dust, etc.
co-ordinate the installation of connectivity with the drainage and irrigation system
co-ordinate with the experts for installation of various environmental control measures and technology
check the quality of the structures installed
test the environment controls for desired operability
check the adequacy of various types of accessories used in installing protected cultivation structures
check the ventilation facility for adequate air circulation suited to crop requirements
check if the irrigation system is functioning adequately

modules.module_title: Inspect the structure for planning the maintenance task

pcs.pc_description: inspect the protected cultivation structure’s effectiveness and stability
check the condition of the various components of the greenhouse
check if the environmental controls such as cooling, heating, humidification, fertigation, carbon dioxide level control and lighting are functioning as per the requirement
inspect the functioning of the facility with respect to changing weather conditions
specify maintenance requirements and related information for the protected cultivation structure, facilities and controls to the maintenance team
plan the manpower required and the timelines for completion of the maintenance tasks
organize tools, equipment and materials required for the maintenance and repair activities
ensure the availability of logbooks and checklist pertaining to the maintenance tasks to be carried out
evaluate the quality of work performed
ensure timely repair and replacement of damaged parts and equipment
ensure tools, equipment and materials are used safely without wastage and damage
ensure cleaning and security of the protected cultivation structure
optimize usage of material including water in various tasks/activities/processes
plug spills/leakages and escalate to appropriate authority if unable to rectify
carry out routine cleaning of tools, machines and equipment
optimize usage of electricity/energy in various tasks/activities/processes
report malfunctioning (fumes/sparks/emission/vibration/noise) and lapse in maintenance of equipment
ensure electrical equipment and appliances are properly connected and turned off when not in use
segregate waste into different categories
dispose non-recyclable waste appropriately
deposit recyclable and reusable material at identified location
follow soil conservation practices

pcs.pc_description: select commercially viable vegetable crop and variety that can be grown under protected cultivation
select and set up protected structure based on the type of vegetable crop, environmental conditions, expected yield, budgets and resources available, etc.
assess and adjust the environmental conditions within the protected structure based on the requirement of the vegetable crop
select appropriate growth media for vegetable crop
decontaminate the media using methods such as chemical drenching/ fumigation, steaming, pasteurization and solarization
ensure the soil media is free from weeds and pests
prepare the soil media to have the desired pH, porosity, moisture retention capacity, salinity, organic content and anchorage for the vegetable crop
ensure the farming soil bed is raised high to prevent water logging
prepare for usage of soilless media by installation of infrastructure
prepare the soil-less media in correct proportion to have dissolved nutrients, fertilizers and manures for the vegetable crop
select planting material for vegetable crop such as seed, seedlings raised in nurseries, tissue cultured plantlets, etc.
clean and prepare the planting material
ensure the seed varieties are first- generation hybrids for optimal seed propagation
plant the seeds/seedlings at the right time ensuring optimum planting density
use low tunnel technique for covering the planted vegetable crops like cucumber, tomato, pepper and beans, till pollination of flowers
prepare daily/weekly irrigation and fertigation schedule as per the requirement of the crop
irrigate the crop using appropriate irrigation system such as micro-irrigation system/foggers or mist system
prepare and apply appropriate dose of manure fertilizer as per the crop requirement
apply micro-nutrients by foliar spray
carry out centring (or decentring) to promote the growth of auxiliary buds and lateral branches as per the requirement of the plant
trim the growing branches for further lateral branch formation, good spread and budding surface
prune the plants as per the pruning cycle
carry out plant management practices such as pinching, disbudding, de-shooting, defoliation, removal of faded vegetables and bending of shoots as required
manage the weeds using appropriate method
identify symptoms of disease, pest infestation, disorder and damage to the vegetable crop
apply appropriate measures for prevention and treatment of disease, pest infestation, disorder and damage to the vegetable crop
select the appropriate harvesting method
harvest the vegetables as per the market requirement
store the vegetable produce temporarily, post-harvest without damaging it
use weighing machines to weigh the harvested produce accurately
sort and grade the harvested produce based on quality, colour and size
arrange buyers for the segregated produce which are not meeting the quality standards
pack, store and transport the marketable produce, ensuring that the produce remains fresh and damage free for a long time
market and sell the produce
complete the records required for the harvest and post-harvest activities

pcs.pc_description: select a site with ample sunlight, distant from low lying area and suitable environmental conditions for flower crop under protected cultivation
select commercially viable varieties of flowers that can be grown under protected cultivation in the selected site such as rose, gerbera, carnation, anthurium, lilium, orchids, chrysanthemum, etc.
set up structure for protected cultivation based on types of flower crop, conditions to be altered, output volumes, budgets and resources available, etc.
apply measures to test and alter the environmental conditions within the protected cultivation structure based on the requirements of the flower crop
select appropriate soil or soilless medium for the flower crop
prepare the media to have appropriate pH, porosity, moisture retention, salinity, organic content and anchorage as required for the flower crop
decontaminate the media using methods such as chemical drenching/ fumigation, steaming, pasteurization and solarization
ensure flat planting bed for flowers
select planting material like, seeds or saplings, tissue cultured plantlets based on the flower variety and planting medium
apply appropriate propagation method for the flower crop such as shield or T-budding, stenting method, cuttings, micro-propagation
prepare the planting material such as seeds, seedlings or cuttings
plant the planting material maintaining the right spacing to ensure optimum planting density
prepare daily/weekly irrigation and fertigation schedule as per the requirement of the crop
apply appropriate micro-irrigation techniques including use of fertigation equipment, spraying system, exhaust fan and cooling pads as per the stage of growth of the flower crop
ensure good quality of filtered water for flower crop
manage weeds using appropriate method
prepare and apply appropriate dose of manure fertilizer as per crop requirement
apply micro-nutrients by foliar spray
carry out centering (or decentering), to promote the growth of auxiliary buds and lateral branches as per the requirement of the plant using wired nets
trim the growing branches for further lateral branch formation, good spread and budding surface
prune and trim the terminal of the plants as per their cycle
carry out the plant management practices of pinching, disbudding, de-shooting, defoliation, removal of faded flowers and bending of shoots as per plant requirement
identify indicators of disease, infestation, disorder and damage to the flower crop
apply appropriate measures for prevention and treatment of disease, infestation, disorder and damage to the flower crop
select appropriate harvesting practices of loose and cut flower
harvest the flowers as per the market requirement in terms of stage of harvest, stem length, bud size, quality and quantity of produce, type of packaging, etc.
pack the flowers for temporary storage
use weighing machine to accurately weigh the produce
sort and grade the harvested produce based on quality, colour, stem strength and size
process the segregated produce which are not meeting the quality standards
pack, store and transport the marketable produce, ensuring that the produce remains fresh and damage free for a long time
record the details of harvest and post- harvest activities in the desired format
